boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-admission art, science, civic, and outdoor stops connected to Ohio State and Columbus.

cards.title: Browse comics and cartoon art
cards.subtitle: Sullivant Hall, 1813 N. High St.
cards.notes: Look through the galleries, then request collection material for the reading room if you want a longer comics-focused visit.
cards.short_summary: Free public galleries and a reading room devoted to cartoons and comics.
cards.evidence_claim: The Billy Ireland Cartoon Library & Museum states that its galleries and reading room are open to the public and admission is free.
cards.source_title: Visit | Billy Ireland Cartoon Library & Museum
cards.access_notes: Free for all; check the museum gallery and reading-room hours before visiting.

cards.title: Inspect fossils in Orton Hall
cards.subtitle: Orton Hall, south side of the Oval
cards.notes: Use the museum’s self-guided highlights to spot fossils and building details, and call ahead during summer for that day’s gallery access.
cards.short_summary: A free geology museum inside one of the Oval’s landmark buildings.
cards.evidence_claim: The Orton Geological Museum states that admission is open to all people and is free.
cards.source_title: Visit The Museum | Orton Geological Museum
cards.access_notes: Free admission; regular-year gallery hours are normally weekdays, with irregular summer hours.

cards.entity_name: Wexner Center for the Arts Galleries
cards.title: See contemporary art
cards.subtitle: 1871 N. High St.
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition listing, then spend time in the galleries during regular public hours without buying a gallery ticket.
cards.short_summary: Contemporary-art exhibitions with free gallery entry.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wexner Center for the Arts states that gallery admission is free for all audiences during regular hours.
cards.source_title: Exhibitions | Wexner Center for the Arts
cards.access_notes: Gallery admission is free during regular hours; separately ticketed programs may differ.

cards.title: Visit an Oval-side gallery
cards.subtitle: Hopkins Hall, Ohio State’s Columbus campus
cards.notes: Pair a gallery visit with an Oval walk, and use the exhibition calendar because the gallery opens around listed exhibitions and events.
cards.short_summary: Campus gallery showing work by students, faculty, staff, and collaborators.
cards.evidence_claim: Hopkins Hall Gallery states that all of its events and exhibitions are always free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Hopkins Hall Gallery | Urban Arts Space
cards.access_notes: Events and exhibitions are free and public; confirm the current exhibition schedule before going.

cards.title: Walk through downtown exhibitions
cards.subtitle: 50 W. Town St., Lazarus Building
cards.notes: Use the gallery’s current exhibition page to plan a daytime downtown art stop, then take in the work at your own pace.
cards.short_summary: Ohio State’s downtown gallery space with free public programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Urban Arts Space states that all of its events and exhibitions are always free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Exhibitions and programs are free; the galleries are open only during exhibitions and events.

cards.title: Take a labeled garden walk
cards.subtitle: 2001 Fyffe Ct., Columbus
cards.notes: Follow the garden map slowly, compare plant labels, and keep to open paths while checking seasonal notices before you set out.
cards.short_summary: A self-guided outdoor walk through Ohio State plant collections.
cards.evidence_claim: Chadwick Arboretum & Learning Gardens identifies its public gardens as free to visit.
cards.access_notes: Garden visits are free; consult current garden and seasonal access information before arrival.

cards.title: Climb the outdoor wall
cards.subtitle: Scioto Audubon Metro Park, 400 W. Whittier St.
cards.notes: Bring the required personal gear, review wall rules, and use the auto-belays only when they are installed for the season.
cards.short_summary: A free outdoor climbing facility in a Columbus Metro Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Columbus and Franklin County Metro Parks describes the Scioto Audubon climbing wall as a free outdoor climbing wall.
cards.access_notes: The wall is free; climbers must bring a harness, and seasonal hours and auto-belay availability apply.

cards.title: Try the outdoor obstacle course
cards.subtitle: Scioto Audubon Metro Park, 400 W. Whittier St.
cards.notes: Wear closed-toe shoes, warm up first, and choose obstacles that match your group’s comfort level before repeating a circuit.
cards.short_summary: A free outdoor fitness course surrounded by a running track.
cards.evidence_claim: Columbus and Franklin County Metro Parks identifies Scioto Audubon’s obstacle course as free.
cards.access_notes: The obstacle course is free to use; follow posted park rules and use it during park open hours.

cards.title: See rotating Ohio art
cards.subtitle: Main Library, 96 S. Grant Ave.
cards.notes: Take the second floor at Main Library for a quiet art stop, then use the library’s public seating for a low-key conversation.
cards.short_summary: A free library gallery featuring established and emerging Ohio artists.
cards.evidence_claim: Columbus Metropolitan Library states that exhibits at the Losinski Gallery are free to attend.
cards.source_title: Losinski Gallery at Main Library | Columbus Metropolitan Library
cards.access_notes: Gallery exhibits are free to attend; check Main Library hours before traveling downtown.

cards.title: Join a Statehouse tour
cards.subtitle: Map Room, 1 Capitol Square
cards.notes: Arrive a few minutes before the hour at the Map Room for a walk-in tour, or take the self-guided route when it suits your group.
cards.short_summary: A free daily guided or self-guided look inside Ohio’s Statehouse.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ohio Statehouse offers free guided tours daily except on state holidays and permits self-guided tours.
cards.access_notes: Free guided walk-in tours run daily except state holidays; groups of 10 or more should arrange ahead.
